title: 2 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on 2 Kings 8: the Shunammite's land restored, Hazael and Benhadad, and the kings Jehoram and Ahaziah of Judah.

questions.text: For how long did Elisha say the famine would come on the land?
questions.explanation: Elisha told the woman that Yahweh had called for a famine, and that it would come on the land for seven years.

questions.text: Where did the woman live with her household during the famine?
questions.explanation: The woman did according to the man of God's word and lived in the land of the Philistines for seven years.

answers.text: In the land of the Philistines

questions.text: Who was telling the king about Elisha's great deeds when the woman came to him?
questions.explanation: The king was talking with Gehazi, the servant of the man of God, and as he was telling how Elisha restored the dead to life, the woman came.

questions.text: What did Hazael bring to Elisha as a present from Benhadad?
questions.explanation: Hazael took a present of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels' burden, and came and stood before Elisha.

answers.text: Ten talents of silver and six thousand pieces of gold
A chariot with horses and ten changes of clothing
Two mules' burden of earth from Syria
Forty camels' burden of every good thing of Damascus

questions.text: What did the man of God do after settling his gaze on Hazael?
questions.explanation: Elisha settled his gaze steadfastly on Hazael until he was ashamed, and then the man of God wept.

questions.text: What did Hazael call himself when Elisha told him the evil he would do?
questions.explanation: Hazael said, 'But what is your servant, who is but a dog, that he could do this great thing?'

questions.text: What happened to Hazael's master on the day after Hazael returned to him?
questions.explanation: On the next day a thick cloth was dipped in water and spread on his face, so that he died; then Hazael reigned in his place.

answers.text: He died of his sickness in the night
He was killed in battle at Ramoth Gilead
His servants struck him with the sword
A thick cloth dipped in water was spread on his face

questions.text: Whose daughter did Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat marry?
questions.explanation: Jehoram walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did Ahab's house, for he married Ahab's daughter.

answers.text: The daughter of the king of Edom

questions.text: Who revolted from under the hand of Judah and made a king over themselves?
questions.explanation: In Jehoram's days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah and made a king over themselves.

questions.text: What was the name of the mother of Ahaziah king of Judah?
questions.explanation: Ahaziah's mother's name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri king of Israel.
